_comment: Curated, hand-maintained baseline + label pointers for the Gemma KB. The builder reads this and never rewrites it. The policy baseline is the one named here; it is confirmed against curated/submissions.csv (external source: Kaggle `competitions submissions gemma-4-developer-agent --csv`, pulled 2026-10-13 by the top-level session).

baseline.label: v6w
baseline.note: v6w SCORED 0.15 (submission 57098497), beating v6 @ 0.12 (submission 56806249, 2026-10-03). This supersedes the old 'v6 @ 0.12 sacred' baseline from the user brief and gemma-submission-protocol.md. The log's live-best claim (~L8389-8436) is SUPPORTED by submissions history. Config: 0.18 budget (28 calls / 8 min / 80 turns / 240s timeout), 9-tool surface with edit_file primary, thinking_budget 1024.
baseline.config_source_hint: look for the submit dir / notebook whose config matches 28/8/80/240 + edit_file-primary 9-tool surface + thinking_budget 1024; label v6w; slug family ...-v6w (backs ~10 dirs)

prior_baseline.label: v6
prior_baseline.note: Former live-best, superseded by v6w @ 0.15 on 2026-10-12. Still the reference for several logged A/Bs; keep for prior-art diffs.

pending.label: branch_final
pending.note: PER-TASK BRANCHING; resolved rich_3676 on its gate (described as first hard-task resolve). NO public score yet (PENDING) -> cannot be the baseline; any verdict depending on its score is NEEDS-DATA until it scores.

notes: LB scores by version are authoritative from curated/submissions.csv, not from the log or config-label '0.18' strings (those are budget labels, not scores).
